answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: Fixes are tiered 'Fix these before launch' (1-8), 'Fix soon after' (9-14) and 'Smaller items', with a 'What I'd do first' list. It says 'I could not drive a real browser or a screen reader' and to 'run each fix on a real phone with dark mode on, and with VoiceOver', and marks the drill-name width as an estimate.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts closed days; refused only at Confirm, with no way back
mapping.reason: Same as D06: any calendar day, closed ones included, can be picked without warning, the closed-day error appears only after tapping Confirm reservation, and the day cannot be changed from the basket or confirm page, so the member has to go back to the tool page.

mapping.title: Days before a tool's available-from date are never checked
mapping.reason: D14: nothing marks, disables or checks the days before the 'Available from' date, so a tool can be reserved for a day before it is in (the sander from 21 October reserved for 10 October parallels the tile-saw example).

mapping.title: Tool-page pick-up day and basket session can disagree
mapping.reason: D15: the day chosen on the tool page and the session chosen in the basket are separate and never reconciled; the confirm page shows Saturday 17 October for the tool and Wednesday 21 October for the session.

mapping.title: Unannounced 10-minute basket hold ends in a generic error that retries cannot clear
mapping.reason: D10: the basket only says items are held and shows no time for the ten-minute hold, and on lapse Continue says just 'Something went wrong. Try again.'; the point that retrying never helps is the same lapse handling, and the proposed fix (state the limit, say it ran out, offer to hold again) fixes D10.

mapping.title: Tool names cut to one line; both drills read the same on a phone
mapping.reason: D03: names are kept on one line with an ellipsis, so at 375 px both cordless drills show the same truncated name and 'two batteries' versus 'one battery' is hidden.

mapping.title: On phones the search form sits below all ten tool cards
mapping.reason: D01: at 480 px and below the stylesheet puts the list of tools before the search form, so a member sees ten cards first and has to scroll past them to reach search and the date filter.

mapping.title: Filters button is an unlabelled three-line icon that looks like a menu
mapping.reason: D01 names the icon-only three-line button as the only way to the date and category filters; giving it a visible 'Filters' label is a narrower fix to the same discoverability problem.

mapping.title: Desktop keyboard order: results come before the form in the code
mapping.reason: Wrong as stated: D01 in the packet says the document order is form then results, so at desktop width focus reaches the search first and no one has to tab through ten tool links before it; the real order mismatch is the phone reorder already counted in R6.

mapping.title: A search with no matches leaves the old list and says nothing
mapping.reason: D02: with no matching tool the previous results stay on screen, no message appears and nothing is announced, so the member cannot tell whether the search ran or found nothing.

mapping.title: Search matches only the exact phrase ('battery' vs 'batteries')
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: D02 is the missing no-match feedback, not what counts as a match. If only the exact phrase matches, a member who types a different word form or word order from the tool name misses tools the library has and may conclude they are not stocked.

mapping.title: Confirm form rejects normal membership and mobile number formats
mapping.reason: D17: the membership number must be exactly 'FT-' plus five digits and the mobile '0xxxx xxxxxx', with no normalising, so 'Ft-01234', 'FT 01234', '+44 7700 900123' and '07700 900 123' are rejected.

mapping.title: Confirm stays enabled during the wait; a double tap books the tool twice
mapping.reason: D12: 'Confirm reservation' stays active with no visible busy state during the 1.5-second wait, and a second press allocates a second reservation number.

mapping.title: Basket Continue has the same silent wait
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: D12 is the Confirm button and its double booking, D10 the lapsed-hold message. On the basket page Continue stays active and shows nothing while it waits, so a member on a phone cannot tell whether the tap registered and taps again or thinks the site is stuck.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge is 3.07:1 and has no visible shape
mapping.reason: D04: in the dark theme the badge text #2f7d4a on the card surface #1d2622 is about 3.1:1, below 4.5:1; the note that the badge background equals the card colour concerns the same badge's dark tokens and is fixed by the same change.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions shown in reverse date order on phones
mapping.reason: D11: row-reverse with reversed wrapping puts the earliest session last on screen while it comes first in the document, so keyboard and screen-reader order run against what is seen.

mapping.title: After 'Reserve this tool' the toast is brief and there is no clear next step
mapping.reason: About the feedback after the press (1.2-second toast, nothing lasting nearby, only the small 'Basket (1)' link), not the false belief that the tool is already reserved, so D07 rather than D26.

mapping.title: Fixed bottom action bar covers the focused day and the footer phone number
mapping.reason: D08: the 72 px fixed bar has only 8 px of clearance below the content, so a focused calendar day can sit under it and the footer's desk phone number is hidden.

mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown traps Tab and will not close on Escape or a tap outside
mapping.reason: D09: inside the custom listbox Tab only cycles the options and Escape does nothing, so a keyboard user cannot leave without choosing; the tap-outside point is the same list that cannot be dismissed.

mapping.title: 'Choose a day' error not announced; focus jumps to a closed first day
mapping.reason: D19: the 'Choose a pick-up day first.' message has no live region and is not referenced by the calendar, so it is not announced, and focus moves to the first day button, a closed day.

mapping.title: After confirming, the basket stays full and the hold timer keeps running
mapping.reason: D18: the basket is not emptied after 'Reservation confirmed'; clearing the basket and timer on confirmation, as proposed, fixes it.

mapping.title: Done page opened without a reservation shows a made-up number FT-4471
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. A member who reopens the done page without a stored reservation sees a confirmation with a number that is not theirs, and may believe a tool is waiting or quote that number at the desk.

mapping.title: Reservation numbers look like membership numbers
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. Both identifiers start with 'FT-' (FT-4471, FT-01234), so a member can give the desk the wrong one or type a reservation number into the membership field and have it rejected.

mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice to screen readers
mapping.reason: D24: the visually hidden copy of the tool name next to the visible list item makes screen readers read the reserved tool twice.

mapping.title: Confirm page 'Change' link does not say what it changes
mapping.reason: Not D13, which is Change dropping the chosen session; renaming the link would not fix that. A screen-reader member moving through the links hears only 'Change' and cannot tell it is for the pick-up session.

mapping.title: Results grid's 330 px minimum column scrolls sideways at 320 px and 200% zoom
mapping.reason: D05: the grid asks for columns at least 330 px wide, so at 320 px and at 200% zoom the cards overflow and the page scrolls sideways.

mapping.title: 'Up to three tools at a time' is not enforced
mapping.reason: D21: the stated three-tool limit is not checked, so a fourth tool is accepted and confirmed.

mapping.title: Done page fallback says 'See your confirmation text' though no such text is promised
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. It sends a member to a confirmation text they were never told to expect (texts are mentioned only for late returns), so a member who gets that fallback looks for a message that may not come and has no record of the reservation.
